note:
Seeded at 0. odoo.tests was measured by NO type gate: mypy.ini scopes the six framework packages, and odoo.tools and odoo.cli carry their own floors, so the test *framework* -- TransactionCase, HttpCase, Form, the Chrome CDP driver, the suite runner, the result reporter -- sat outside all three. Every addon test in the repository runs on it.

WHY IT WAS MISSED FOR LONGER THAN odoo.cli. The package is named `tests`, and `tooling/architecture/_sources.py::is_test_path` calls any path with a `tests` component a test path. So beyond the type gates it is also invisible to py_function_length, sql_in_placeholder, py_count_as_boolean, py_x2many_count, compute_context_deps and every test_lint AST rule -- measured clean on all of those, but measured, not merely assumed. It scored 250 errors in 13 of its 14 modules the first time mypy was pointed at it.

THE FLOOR OPENS AT ZERO: all 250 are fixed in the commit that opens it, so this scope has no fungible slack and any new error fails on its own. Its own floor, not folded into mypy, mypy_tools or mypy_cli, for the reason py_typecheck.yml gives for keeping those apart: one integer over several scopes makes every future move ambiguous between them.

One finding the 250 contained rather than merely annotated: form.py's Form.__init__ reused its `view` parameter as the local for the processed view dict, so `self._view` inherited the parameter's `int | str | BaseModel | None`. One line, 45 of the 250.
